name: Timeout budget checker
blurb: A call chain's per-try timeouts and retries, top first: the worst case when the bottom hangs, whether it fits the caller's deadline, and which retries can never finish in time.

inputs.label: The chain
inputs.description: One call per line, top first: caller -> callee, the per-try timeout (ms, s, or none), and the retries. A # starts a comment. Assumes every layer retries a try that timed out.
inputs.default:
frontend -> checkout    none   2
checkout -> pricing     1s     2
pricing -> inventory    500ms  2

inputs.label: Top caller waits
inputs.description: How long whatever calls the top of the chain waits: the app, the browser, the gateway.

inputs.label: Backoff between tries
inputs.description: Wait before each retry. Envoy waits a random 0 to 24 ms before the first retry, more after.

samples.label: Timeouts set by hand, every timeout retried

input.chain:
frontend -> checkout    none   2
checkout -> pricing     1s     2
pricing -> inventory    500ms  2

frontend -> checkout    1.8s   0
checkout -> pricing     800ms  1
pricing -> inventory    225ms  2

frontend -> checkout    none   0
checkout -> pricing     none   0
pricing -> inventory    none   0
